profile.headline: Software Engineer at US Xpress Inc

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description:
Developed several major trade options allocation systems. Projects were developed with no knowledge of the system. My only requirement document was to review an existing program.
*	Maintenance and support of major trade option systems 
*	Programming experience in financial services 
*	Developed several oneshot utility programs to accomodate data integrity 
*	Free Format style coding preferred 
*	Adapt to companies system applications with no difficulty 
*	Research problems discovered by QA testers
*	Thoroughly understand SDLC process
*	Superior analysis skills
*	Continued research on new technologies
*	Technical lead on various financial systems
*	Environment: AS/400, RPGIV, Embedded SQL, CL/400, ILE, service programs, subprocedures, subfiles, Aldon change mgmt utility

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description:
Developed and maintain several freight bill system applications. 
With little or no knowledge, perform extensive analysis on freight bill systems prior to providing an intelligent solution 
Create trigger programs to validate company contractor information. 
Developed business rules maintenance program using subfile concept 
Key player in developing auto corrections freight bill system. My responsibilities consist of analyzing, design documentation, meeting with customers to discuss business solution, modifying and creating new application modules to accommodate business requirement. 
Environment: AS/400, RPGIV, Embedded SQL, CL/400, ILE, sub-procedures, service programs, subfiles, trigger programs, Implementer change mgmt utility

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description:
Developed back-end application client server order entry system. 
Perform extensive analysis on current order entry system prior to new development 
On amazon.com, customer selects order information provided by Performance Inc. Order information  imported via FTP to AS400 environment. The order information generates order entry file to process during shipment. 
Maintain and support PKMS WMS. 
Using MQSeries product, developed automated messaging system to transmit Orders from different platforms using queue management. 
Environment: AS/400, RPGIV, Embedded SQL, CL/400, ILE, sub-procedures, service programs, subfiles, MQSeries Middleware Communication Tool, Manhattan PKMS WMS

positions.title: is Sr. Software Designer
positions.description:
Re-designing POWERMHS medical claims systems to reflect Cigna's Healthcare needs. Primary functions are performing analysis and writing application design specification documents. 
Analyze POWERMHS programs to determine the best design approach to apply during the design phase, with little or no business knowledge, adapt quickly to systems business functionality. 
Coordinate design specs with offsite developers to create program specifications 
Review program specifications from offsite developers prior to construction 
During construction phase, performed code walkthroughs with offsite developers insuring design specifications are in sync with program specification 
Apply very strict formalize SDLC process methodology 
Environment: AS/400, POWERMHS, COBOL/400, RPGIV, Embedded SQL, CL/400, ILE, Intrinsics commands

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description:
Developed Client(Java)/Server(COBOL) Retail Store System. My team was responsible for server development. 
Applied ILE methodology to systems. 
Extensive interaction with activation groups, binding directories and service programs 
Environment: AS/400, retail software, COBOL/400, ILE, Intrinsics commands

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description:
Developed several subsystems to interface with PowerMHS using PowerMHS file structure. 
Developed PowerMHS pre-edit utility system. In addition, I developed a subscriber count system and PowerMHS rate system. 
Environment: AS/400, PowerMHS, COBOL/400, Intrinsics commands, Embedded SQL

company.name: Blue Cross and Blue Shields of North Carolina

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Initially Consultant, hired after three months to Programmer/Analyst 
Perform planning, analysis, design, construction, testing, implementation and support of healthcare Mgmt. Systems(PowerMHS). 
Primary duties were production support and maintenance of all healthcare systems using SDLC process. 
Languages were both COBOL/400 and RPGIV/400. 
Converted several systems from COBOL/400 to RPGIV/400. 
Developed several subsystems to interface with PowerMHS using PowerMHS file structure. 
Created several embedded SQL RPGIV/400 and COBOL/400 programs. 
Assist in developing large scale invoicing system that would generate bills to pay doctors. 
Developed EDI/Extol tool for E-Commerce to automate mappings of specific fields based on business rules. 
Developed hospital payment review system(HPR) to validate doctors ICD9 & CPT codes are reported accurately.
Used file transfer protocol to transmit files to and from the AS400. 
Very analytical in resolving system problems with little or no knowledge of various systems. 
Functioning liason interpreting user needs into Technical Specifications. 
Frequently primary oncall in case a problem arouse during the middle of the night. 
Subfile development 
Environment: AS/400, POWERMHS, COBOL/400, RPGIV, Embedded SQL, CL/400, ILE, subprocedures, service programs, subfiles,Intrinsics commands

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description:
Responsible for planning, analysis, design, development and implementation of customer service system. 
Assist in developing phone order system used to order Pitney Bowes office supplies via telephone. 
Environment: Pc based, FoxPro for Windows 2.6a

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description:
Responsible for analysis and programming of a tax credit system using COBOL/400 and Foxpro. 
Front-end FoxPro interface and the back-end developed in COBOL/400. Efforts utilized TCP/IP and ODBC. 
Environment: AS/400, PC based, FoxPro for Windows, COBOL/400

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Job responsibilities consist of accounting systems programming, maintenance and support using COBOL. 
Other requirements included user interaction, training and technical assistance 
Developed A/R system from systems analyst specification 
Create tracking system to locate document during developmental phases. In addition created barcodes used  by scanning equipment. 
Responsible for tape backup backup system development. The system retrieve specific documents from tape library database 
Create several mainframe to PC communication packages. 
Environment: Data General MV10000 and MV20000, INFOS, COBOL
